BUYER GUIDE / BY KUMAR SAURABH MISHRA

Start with what you need to edit.

A platform decision should follow your content, transactions, and maintenance capacity.

Simple information sites

A static site can suit a small, stable set of pages. It has fewer moving parts, but editing may require a straightforward source workflow or an added content editor.

Regular publishing

If several people publish frequently, evaluate editing roles, previews, revisions, and portability. Ask for a demonstration of the exact publishing tasks you need.

Selling and integrations

For commerce, consider product management, payment requirements, shipping, taxes, and third-party systems. Confirm availability and fees directly with the chosen provider before committing.
